body.decision_requirement: The target permit.decision.v1 claim MUST be supported and MUST cover resource_attributes_json through resource_attributes_canonical_hash.
body.cross_binding: The exact semantic binding, authorization facts, and trusted classification MUST be read from the same resource_attributes_json whose RFC 8785 digest matches the signed decision commitment. A receipt projection is comparison evidence only.

verdicts.supported: the supported signed decision covers exact facts that validate and re-derive the admitted exact action
verdicts.disproved: present signed-decision, receipt, semantic, fact, or classification evidence diverges
verdicts.insufficient_evidence: the supported signed decision, committed attributes, or required pinned contract is missing
verdicts.unverifiable_scope: the semantic, fact profile, schema, or classification recipe is unsupported
